draft.subject: PerspectAI acquisition: an AI employee for Unstop's post-deal operations
draft.body:
Dear Ankit,

I noticed Unstop recently acquired PerspectAI in an all-equity deal to integrate behavioral intelligence into your hiring platform. As you scale these operations, Zamp provides AI employees that learn a job from your team and then own the process end-to-end. Our agents work through any existing interface, including legacy terminals and APIs, without requiring any engineering effort from your side. I would love to set up a call with you or your respective team to take this forward, at a time that suits you.

Warm regards,
Anish
